ITEM 1 | Brown grain mixture, dark reddish-brown to tan kernels with glossy sheen, some dark specks and small dried red fruit pieces mixed in, mounded in a heap on upper left of plate, about 40% of plate area, roughly 3 cm tall, moist and holding shape | 190
ITEM 2 | Pinkish-orange cooked fish pieces, flaked and browned at edges with golden crust, chunks about 2-3 cm, some flaky texture, with small green herb leaves and rice-like grains mixed in, lower left of plate, about 25% of plate area, roughly 2 cm tall | 150
ITEM 3 | Diced vegetable medley with small cubes of green cucumber-like pieces, red bell pepper cubes, yellow squash cubes about 1 cm, pale green chunks, with tan rice grains and green herb leaves, upper right of plate, about 20% of plate area, roughly 2 cm tall, moist and glistening | 110
ITEM 4 | Large dark green leaves, wilted and glossy, a few sprigs on upper right edge beside the diced vegetables, about 5% of plate area, flat and thin | 10
ITEM 5 | Sliced yellow squash pieces, pale yellow with lighter edges, about 3 cm wide chunks, soft and slightly glossy, lower right of plate beside dark green zucchini slices, about 8% of plate area, roughly 1.5 cm tall | 40
ITEM 6 | Sliced dark green zucchini rounds with darker skin, about 2-3 cm long pieces, firm and slightly glossy, lower right of plate next to yellow squash, about 5% of plate area, roughly 1.5 cm tall | 30
